domain_note: 本动画纵向波形为无耗传输线沿线电压分布图示，非材料机械横向振动；沿线点为空间电位采样点。

equations.incident_voltage_wave: u_i(x, t) = A * cos(omega * t - beta * x)
equations.reflected_voltage_wave: u_r(x, t) = A * cos(omega * t + beta * x)
equations.standing_voltage_wave: u(x, t) = 2 * A * cos(beta * x) * cos(omega * t)
equations.boundary_condition: x = 0 处开路终端全反射 (Gamma = +1), u_i(0, t) = u_r(0, t) => Delta_phi = 0 (同相强化波腹)
